meta_data.base_class: look up the function of a molecule within a specific <organelle> - different organelles are structurally and functionally independent yet comparable.

tool_template.name: function_lookup_in_<class>
tool_template.description: Look up the function of a given molecule in the <class>.

molecule.description: The molecule of interest in the <class>.

specific_function.description: If set to true, a specific function of the molecule within the <class> will be provided, if such information exists.

organism_type.description: The type of organism which contains the <class> being studied.

temperature_condition.description: The temperature condition under which the function of the molecule in the <class> is examined.

pH_level.description: The pH level at which the molecule's function is being analyzed in the <class>.

time_of_day.description: The time of day during which the molecule's function is being observed in the <class>.

is_mutated.description: Indicates whether the molecule in the <class> has any known mutations affecting its function.
